public.text: The ethics principle focuses strongly on secondary use and AI training. Ethical architectural concerns also include exclusion, surveillance, power asymmetry, group harms, inappropriate linkage, and repurposing of infrastructure.
public.suggestedRevision: Expand the principle to require ethical and human-rights impact assessment for high-risk architectural decisions, including identity linkage, biometrics, cross-sector data sharing, population profiling, and secondary-use platforms.
